settings.farewell: {name} says goodbye to {heir} and retires to {place} at {age}.

hearthmere.name: The Lantern and Last Coin
hearthmere.text: Low beams, a dog by the fire, and swords for hire along the back wall.

ironford.name: The Anvil's Rest
ironford.text: Smiths drink here after the forges bank. The hirelings sit nearest the door.

kingshold.name: The Crown and Candle
kingshold.text: Knights without lords and scholars without patrons share the long tables.

brinehaven.name: The Salt Anchor
brinehaven.text: Tar, fish stew and sailors' gossip. Half the room is waiting for a ship.

companions.name: Bren Cask
companions.personality: Former caravan guard. Counts his coin twice and his friends once.
companions.farewell: {name} counts the coin one last time, buys a share in a fishing boat and retires to {place} at {age}.

companions.name: Maddy Thorn
companions.personality: Laughs at the wrong moments and never misses the right ones.
companions.farewell: {name} laughs that the roads have grown longer, kisses {heir} on both cheeks and retires to {place} at {age}.

companions.name: Sister Oriel
companions.personality: Left the temple before her vows. Still prays before every fight, and after.
companions.hint: A young woman in a grey habit watches the door. She wants a patron with some battles behind them.
companions.farewell: {name} blesses {heir} one last time and goes to the temple in {place} to take the vows after all, at {age}.

companions.name: Hulda Stonebrow
companions.personality: Mine-guard. Claims she has buried more goblins than coin, and she is not poor.
companions.hint: A dwarf in a dented helm says she does not guard green recruits.
companions.farewell: {name} hangs the dented helm over the door and goes home to the mines of {place} at {age}.

companions.name: Tarsk Ember-Eye
companions.personality: Cast out of the forge-temples for asking why the fire answers.
companions.hint: A dragonborn with a scorched sleeve sizes up every sword that walks in. Not yours, yet.
companions.farewell: {name} goes back to the forge-temples of {place} at {age}, still asking why the fire answers.

companions.name: Varn Deepdelver
companions.personality: Tunnel scout. Went quiet after Deepstone and only talks about what he saw there to those who have seen it.
companions.hint: A grey-bearded scout sits with his back to the wall and his eyes on the door.
companions.farewell: {name} has seen enough tunnels for one life and retires to {place} at {age}, back to the wall, eyes on the door.

companions.name: Ser Aldric Vane
companions.personality: A knight without a lord, still polishing a crest he no longer wears.
companions.hint: A knight in faded colours will only swear to a name that has drawn blood.
companions.farewell: {name} lays the old crest in {heir}'s hands, kneels once more and retires to {place} at {age}.

companions.name: Ysolde Marrow
companions.personality: Speaks to the dead politely and to the living rarely.
companions.hint: The barkeep says an elf comes to Kingshold whenever the barrows grow restless.
companions.farewell: {name} thanks {heir} politely and goes to keep the dead company at {place}, at {age}.

companions.name: Corwin Saltmere
companions.personality: A charming liar with marked cards, a knife in each boot and a spell for the third.
companions.hint: A smiling half-elf deals cards to himself. He works only for someone worth robbing.
companions.farewell: {name} wins one last pot, pockets the marked deck and retires to {place} at {age}.

companions.name: Old Netta
companions.personality: Mends nets, bones and quarrels, in that order.
companions.hint: An old gnome mending a net says she will not walk the roads with a child.
companions.farewell: {name} mends one last net, then one last quarrel, and retires to {place} at {age}.

companions.name: Grull One-Tusk
companions.personality: Walked away from the war-camps to learn stillness. Mostly learned to punch.
companions.farewell: {name} sits down on the sea wall at {place} at {age} and, at last, learns stillness.

companions.name: The Pale Warden
companions.personality: Kept watch over the Rift seal longer than anyone remembers. Now it is open, she means to see what comes out.
companions.hint: A tall figure in white scale sits alone, facing north towards Highcrag. She will ride only with the house that opens the Rift.
companions.farewell: {name} turns north one last time and goes back to keep watch at {place}, at {age}.
